metadata.title: Merged Food Composition — INNTA + Ciqual 2025 + USDA FoodData Central (de-duplicated)
metadata.description: Union of all foods from the three sources, each mapped onto a shared canonical nutrient set (per 100 g). Nutrient mapping is driven by INFOODS tags (Ciqual) and USDA nutrient numbers (FDC).
metadata.mapping_method: Ciqual columns resolved by INFOODS tag (or origcpcd where a tag is shared by several columns, e.g. energy/protein); FoodData Central columns resolved by USDA nutrient number; INNTA mapped by nutrient identity (no codes in source).

source_roles.FoodDataCentral: generic_ingredient — use for generic raw-ingredient detail (lab-measured)
source_roles.Ciqual: product_or_dish — use for products and composed dishes

standardisation.energy: kcal (Ciqual EU 1169/2011 kcal via origcpcd 328; FDC USDA #208, falling back to Atwater general #957 then specific #958; INNTA kcal)
standardisation.protein: N x 6.25 (Ciqual origcpcd 25003; FDC USDA #203; INNTA as reported)

metadata.value_rule: Only clean numeric values are carried over; anything missing / n.d. / OCR-garbled (INNTA) or - / traces / <LOQ (Ciqual) becomes null. Every food carries `source` and `role`, so every value's provenance is recorded.
caveats: Foods are NOT de-duplicated across sources: the same generic food may appear up to three times (once per source). Use `source` / `role` to choose.
omega3_ala_g / omega6_la_g: INNTA reports generic total omega-3 / omega-6; Ciqual & FDC report the main components ALA (18:3 n-3) and LA (18:2 n-6).
vitamin_e_alpha_tocopherol_mg: Ciqual & FDC are alpha-tocopherol; INNTA 'Vitamine E' is generic and mapped in as an approximation.
trans_fat_g: Ciqual has no total-trans column; salt_g is Ciqual-only; biotin_b8_ug is INNTA/FDC-only; sugars_total_g/lactose_g/starch_g are Ciqual/FDC-only.

deduplication.rule: When the same food (identical normalised name) appears in more than one source, keep one in priority order INNTA > Ciqual > FoodData Central; non-duplicated foods are left unchanged.
deduplication.matching: Names compared after lowercasing, removing accents & punctuation, and collapsing spaces. Only exact normalised-name matches are treated as duplicates (conservative — avoids wrongly merging different foods).
deduplication.note: All removed foods are INNTA<->Ciqual pairs; the INNTA version was kept. The kept food lists the removed match under `also_present_in`. FoodData Central (English names) produced no cross-language matches and is unchanged.
